destination._comment_vat: Israel standard VAT is 18% as of 2025.
destination._comment_tiers: Israel de-minimis: <$75 exempt; $75-$500 VAT only; >$500 VAT + customs. Tiers compared on (item+shipping) value in USD.

_comment_il_shipping: il_shipping values: 'unconfirmed_verify_at_checkout' = ships internationally but Israel not confirmed (could not reach checkout from here); 'verified_no_direct' = store confirmed it does NOT ship to Israel (forwarder required); 'via_forwarder' = domestic-only store, reach Israel through a forwarder below. ships_to_israel = can the shoe reach Israel at all (direct or via forwarder); shipping_cost includes the forwarder leg where one is needed.
